$comment: Plan 25 per-target struct variants — x86-64-linux leg. <sys/stat.h>'s `struct stat` has per-target `variants`; the (arch=x86_64, format=elf) variant is the 144-byte glibc layout, so `sizeof(struct stat)` folds to 144 → st_mode(40)+st_blocks(2)=42. Single elf-x86_64 target (POSIX header → availableObjectFormats:[elf]; no pe/macho arm). Runs natively on the linux CI leg; cross-compiles (compile-checks the real descriptor) locally. The release arm runs the shipped optimizer over the struct sizeof/field shapes. Paired with shipped_struct_stat_arm64 (128B) — the arm64 leg is the red-on-disable witness for the variant selector.

optimizedPipelines.$commentByteIdentical: MEASURED 2026-08-15 — optimized image BYTE-IDENTICAL to the baseline on: x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec. Legs actually run: windows/pe64-x86_64 and linux/elf64 (x86_64 + aarch64 under qemu); the darwin/macho64 leg was NOT run. Where the image is identical the arm's exit-code/stdout comparison is x==x and cannot fail. HONEST: the values here live in an AGGREGATE (struct/union/array) local or global. The shipped pipeline does not promote aggregate storage, so the address-compute/store/load chain survives the pipeline unchanged. The two operands are members of a `struct stat` local. Deliberately NOT given "mustDifferFromBaseline" — an honest no-op, not a missed opt-in.
